advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Skip the store-read-failure backoff sleep on the final attempt to avoid delaying the terminal retryable raise.
evidence: 392: raise PlanReviewGenerationRetryable("plan review generation remained unstable after 3 attempts")
The loop `for attempt in range(1, MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS + 1)` (line 284) means attempt==3 sleeps then continues into the terminal raise, so the sleep delays failure without any retry benefit.
advisory.finding: On the final loop iteration (attempt == MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS), a store-read-failure still runs time.sleep(random.uniform(0, STORE_READ_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS * attempt)) before `continue` exits the loop and immediately raises PlanReviewGenerationRetryable — the backoff on the last attempt is wasted (up to ~0.3s) since no further read will occur.
scenarios: A persistent staged-index contention window that never clears — signing waits an extra backoff interval before returning retryable.
advisory.suggested_fix: Guard the sleep with `if attempt < MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS:` before sleeping, mirroring a no-op final iteration.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Monkeypatch `generation.time.sleep` (and optionally `generation.random`) and assert the per-attempt backoff is bounded/jittered per STORE_READ_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS.
evidence: generation.py:312 `time.sleep(random.uniform(0, STORE_READ_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS * attempt))` is added by this diff

test_persistent_store_read_failure_is_retryable_not_terminal uses `_raising_head(..., fail_times=99)`, driving all 3 attempts through the real sleep with no monkeypatch of `generation.time` or `generation.random`
ABSENCE: no assertion in any new test that the backoff sleep is bounded by STORE_READ_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS*attempt or that jitter is applied
advisory.finding: The newly-added jittered backoff (`time.sleep(random.uniform(0, STORE_READ_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS * attempt))`) is unverified and unmocked: no test asserts the backoff/jitter contract, and the persistent-failure test executes the real `time.sleep` + `random.uniform` (an unmocked clock/RNG boundary) on each of its 3 exhausted attempts.
advisory.suggested_fix: In the persistent-failure test, monkeypatch `generation.time.sleep` to record call args and assert each recorded delay is within [0, STORE_READ_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS*attempt]; this also removes the real sleep from the unit test.
